projects.title: EtherWave
projects.subtitle: Lossless Audio Streaming Utility
projects.description: An open-source desktop application designed to capture system audio via loopback pipelines and stream it to secondary devices over a local network. Built to solve high-latency issues in wireless audio setups.
features: Lossless Raw PCM 16-bit 48kHz audio streaming over local network
Sub-100ms latency with self-healing buffer compensation algorithms
Bypasses proprietary client apps using WebSockets and Web Audio API
Hardware-inspired console with responsive visualizer and volume control

projects.title: AudioLens
projects.subtitle: AI Clinical Workup for Audiologists
projects.description: A full-featured clinical workup system tailored for audiologists. Provides AI diagnostic assistance across test sections alongside overall clinical report generation.
features: Won 1st Place at SmartAbility Hackathon (College)
Step-by-step AI assistance across 8 diagnostic audiologic test modules
Automated cross-test correlation and comprehensive PDF report generation
Deterministic rule-based clinical scoring engine with AI-driven summary insights

projects.title: Black Onyx
projects.subtitle: Provenance Firewall for AI Agents
projects.description: A firewall for tool-using AI agents. Untrusted tool output (email, web page, file) can be read as data but can never choose a destination or action: every value carries its sources and trust level, and a readable policy checks each tool argument at the moment of use. Paired with Laya, a local small language model that gives an advisory score on whether a tool call fits the user's request.
features: 1st Prize at the Future Forge Buildathon 2026 (national level)
Deterministic rules blocked all 310 attack runs in the team's benchmark
Laya: a 421M-parameter local model used as an advisory sentinel
144 automated tests

projects.title: FloodLine
projects.subtitle: Ward-Level Flood Risk & Alerts for Chennai
projects.description: A flood-warning system that keeps working when the network does not. Ward-level risk is computed on real city polygons with terrain-derived lowness, an LLM planner assists operators while deterministic rules decide evacuation, and a phone app answers questions offline using an on-device model.
features: Second Runner-up at Dreamovation 2.0 (Team Nexora)
Risk map, 24-hour timeline and pump/boat response queue
Photo-based flood-depth estimate with human confirmation
Offline phone app with on-device Llama 3.2 1B, Tamil support and alerts
Automated backend and phone tests
